code:
producer = Producer({
    "bootstrap.servers": "b1:9092,b2:9092,b3:9092",
    "acks": "all",
    "enable.idempotence": True,
})
producer.produce("orders", key=str(cust_id),
                  value=order_json, callback=on_delivery)
producer.flush()
caption: acks=all + enable.idempotence: no order event is lost, and a retry never duplicates it on the broker.
6 partitions: room for a 6-member consumer group. 7-day retention: room to replay if a downstream job needs to reprocess.

code:
consumer = Consumer({
    "bootstrap.servers": "b1:9092,b2:9092,b3:9092",
    "group.id": "orders-processor",
    "enable.auto.commit": False,
})
consumer.subscribe(["orders"])
msg = consumer.poll(1.0)
process_order(msg.value())
consumer.commit(msg)
caption: Manual commit, after processing — an offset only advances once the event has actually been handled.
